title: No Communication with Ex-Team Members Standard
summary: Once someone leaves the Zura Spa team, therapists must maintain professional boundaries and avoid work-related communication about Zura Spa, clients, staff, operations, or internal matters.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: At Zura Spa, once a person is no longer a member of the Zura Spa team, therapists are expected to maintain professional boundaries and avoid work-related communication or engagement with ex-team members concerning Zura Spa, its clients, staff, operations, policies, or internal matters.

This standard is intended to protect the confidentiality, unity, and professional interests of Zura Spa. It is not intended to control therapists' personal lives or private relationships outside the workplace. Where management has a specific policy or lawful requirement concerning contact with a former team member, therapists are expected to follow it.

sections.title: Relevance of This Standard
paragraphs: Maintaining appropriate boundaries with ex-team members is important because it:
list: Protects confidential company information.
Prevents internal matters from being shared outside the organization.
Reduces gossip, misinformation, and unnecessary workplace drama.
Protects client privacy and information.
Prevents former staff from influencing current team members negatively.
Maintains team unity and professionalism.
Helps prevent misunderstandings between current and former staff.
Protects the reputation and interests of Zura Spa.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset
paragraphs: Therapists should understand that leaving the Zura Spa team means the person's professional relationship with the Spa has ended. Current therapists should therefore avoid carrying workplace matters into personal conversations with former team members.
The right mindset should be: "I can respect a former colleague as a person while maintaining my professional boundaries and protecting Zura Spa's confidentiality."
Therapists should not allow friendship, sympathy, curiosity, anger, or personal loyalty to influence their responsibility to the current team.

This standard is particularly important when a former team member asks about clients, staff, schedules, salaries, management decisions, internal disagreements, policies, or other confidential matters.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Do
list: Maintain professional boundaries with former team members.
Keep Zura Spa's internal information confidential.
Politely decline questions about internal Spa matters.
Direct legitimate business-related inquiries to management.
Report inappropriate attempts to obtain confidential information.
Avoid discussing current team members or clients with former staff.
Continue to treat former colleagues respectfully without compromising workplace standards.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Not Do
list: Do not share confidential Zura Spa information with ex-team members.
Do not discuss clients, their information, bookings, or personal matters.
Do not disclose internal staff issues, salaries, schedules, policies, or management decisions.
Do not send screenshots, documents, photographs, or internal messages to former staff.
Do not pass messages between former team members and current staff regarding internal matters.
Do not participate in gossip or negative discussions about Zura Spa with ex-team members.
Do not allow personal friendships to become a reason for breaching confidentiality.
Do not use an ex-team member as a source of workplace gossip or information.
Do not intentionally create a channel for a former employee to remain involved in internal Spa affairs.

sections.title: Zura Spa Mindset
paragraphs: Professional relationships may end, but respect should remain. Confidentiality must remain stronger.
The goal is not hostility toward former team members. The goal is to ensure that current team members remain focused on the current team, current standards, and current responsibilities.
Protect the information. Protect the team. Protect the Zura Spa standard.

remember: Respect former colleagues as people while protecting confidentiality. Protect the information. Protect the team. Protect the Zura Spa standard.
